class.name: SteamServerStatus
class.brief_description: Detached snapshot of a dedicated Game's current Steam readiness and admission.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: True when the exact playerless Game is running with admission open.

method.name: is_advertisement_requested
method.description: True when this world enabled local Steam browser advertisement. Confirm external discoverability by querying from a Steam client.

method.name: is_secure
method.description: True when the dedicated SDK is logged in, reports Steam secure mode, and has a current transport certificate.

method.name: get_authenticated_players
method.description: Number of remote peers verified and admitted by the active Game Session.

method.name: get_world_id
method.description: Stable published world identifier, or empty when no world is published.
